name: Grilled Cheese
body:
Station and Complexity grillardin 1, line cook 1

Flavor Profiles salty
Additional Ingredients bitter, spicy, temperature, texture, or umami

EFFECT

Duration 1 minute/level; Serving Size 1

DESCRIPTION

A grilled cheese is one or more types of cheese melted between slices of bread.

When consumed, it acts as a tanglefoot bag.

Additional spice and temperature ingredients also deal 1d6 fire damage each on a failed save.

Additional bitter, texture, and umami ingredients allow the meal to affect creatures +1 category larger than Medium each.
